left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Age ≥18 years
  -  No systemic diseases  [OR] or pregnancy

right.raw_text: -  Full-mouth plaque score (FMPS) [AND]  and full-mouth bleeding score (FMBS) ≤ 10% (measured at four sites per tooth)

left.raw_text: -  Presence of single RT1 buccal gingival recessions ≥ 2 mm of depth located in the anterior area of the upper jaw (central  [OR] and lateral incisors, [OR]  canine, [OR]  first and second pre-molars, [OR]  first molar) and associated with aesthetic complains  [OR] and or dental sensitivity

right.raw_text:
-  Presence of NCCL associated with recession
  -  No history of mucogingival  [OR] or periodontal surgery at experimental sites

left.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Prosthetic crown at experimental teeth

right.raw_text: -  Gingival recessions presenting minimal amount (< 1mm) of apico-coronal keratinized tissue (KT) extension apical to recession area
